title: Can this result be explained and replayed?
description: Inject one lineage failure and change the captured evidence. The verdict is deterministic: required evidence either exists or it does not.

evidence.label: Input object digests
evidence.detail: Checksum every staged biological object and bind it to the authorized sample manifest.

evidence.label: Reference sequence digest
evidence.detail: Record checksum-addressed reference content, not only an assembly nickname.

evidence.label: Workflow revision
evidence.detail: Retain the reviewed source revision and workflow descriptor used for the run.

evidence.label: Runtime image digest
evidence.detail: Pin the exact runtime image content instead of resolving a mutable tag during replay.

evidence.label: Canonical parameter manifest
evidence.detail: Store parsed parameter values and defaults as immutable run evidence.

evidence.label: Output object digests
evidence.detail: Verify every published result and detect later corruption or replacement.

evidence.label: Attempt and publication log
evidence.detail: Link retries, exit status, validation, and the atomically published winning attempt.

scenarios.label: Input replaced at the same path
scenarios.summary: A staged FASTQ path is unchanged, but its bytes differ from the approved study object.
scenarios.withoutEvidence: The run can silently analyze different biological input under the same location.
scenarios.withEvidence: Staging fails checksum validation before computation, and the approved object remains identifiable.

scenarios.label: Reference alias resolves differently
scenarios.summary: A rerun asks for the same assembly nickname, but the available reference bundle has different sequence content.
scenarios.withoutEvidence: The platform cannot prove that changed calls came from code, parameters, or reference content.
scenarios.withEvidence: The reference mismatch is detected and replay waits for the checksum-addressed sequence.

scenarios.label: Container tag moved
scenarios.summary: A registry tag now points to a newly built image after a tool or dependency update.
scenarios.withoutEvidence: The same workflow source may execute different binaries without a manifest change.
scenarios.withEvidence: The run resolves the retained image digest or fails explicitly when that artifact is unavailable.

scenarios.label: Parameters edited after submission
scenarios.summary: A shared configuration file changes between the original run and an attempted replay.
scenarios.withoutEvidence: The platform cannot distinguish a method change from nondeterministic execution.
scenarios.withEvidence: The canonical run parameters remain available and differ visibly from the edited configuration.

scenarios.label: Published output is corrupted
scenarios.summary: A result object changes after the workflow succeeded and its path remains unchanged.
scenarios.withoutEvidence: The platform may present changed bytes as the result that passed task validation.
scenarios.withEvidence: The output mismatch is detected and the publication log identifies the verified winning attempt.
